overview.pattern: Astro 6 islands architecture with per-route SSR on Cloudflare
overview.description: Static-first personal portfolio site. Pages are pure HTML built at compile time; only the chat widget and small vanilla-JS scripts hydrate on the client. A single API route opts into SSR (prerender=false) to stream LLM responses. Deployed to Cloudflare Pages (static) + Cloudflare Workers (SSR route + cron) at jackcutrara.com.

data-flow.flow: MDX content collections -> Zod-validated frontmatter -> getStaticPaths -> static HTML pages; chat: browser widget -> POST /api/chat (SSE) -> Anthropic Haiku stream -> KV transcript -> cron deliverDue -> Resend email
data-flow.description: Content is authored as MDX in src/content/projects/, validated by Zod schemas at build, and rendered to static pages ordered by project.order. The chat surface streams via SSE and persists transcripts to Cloudflare KV, later swept by a scheduled Worker into email delivery.

conventions.naming: Decision IDs (D-xx), review gaps (WR-xx, CR-xx), and phase tags annotate load-bearing code in comments. Design tokens are six CSS hex custom properties.
conventions.file-organization: src/pages (routes), src/layouts (BaseLayout wrapper), src/components/primitives (scoped-style building blocks), src/lib (pure server modules), src/prompts (LLM prompt builders), src/scripts (client vanilla JS), src/data (typed content constants), src/content/projects (MDX case studies).
conventions.imports: Pure server lib modules avoid cross-coupling to Anthropic SDK, cloudflare:workers, prompts, and browser scripts (D-26 isolation anchor). Client scripts share an IntersectionObserver factory (scripts/lib/observer.ts).

styling.system: Tailwind CSS v4 (Oxide engine) via @tailwindcss/vite plus CSS custom-property design tokens in src/styles/global.css
styling.description: Locked editorial design system per design-system/MASTER.md. Six hex tokens only (--bg, --ink, --ink-muted, --ink-faint, --rule, --accent). Geist + Geist Mono self-hosted via Astro 6 Fonts API. Single light theme, restrained motion. Type role classes (.display, .h1-section, etc.) in global.css.

chat-architecture.pattern: SSE streaming chat widget with hardened Workers SSR backend
chat-architecture.description: Client widget (src/scripts/chat.ts) renders markdown via marked + DOMPurify XSS sanitization. Backend (src/pages/api/chat.ts) enforces exact-origin CORS whitelist, 32KB body cap, Cloudflare rate limiter binding, Zod validation, and prompt-cached Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5 streaming. Transcripts persist to KV (chat-transcripts.ts) fire-and-forget via ctx.waitUntil, with a scheduled cron (chat-delivery.ts) delivering via Resend.

content-collections.pattern: Astro Content Layer with Zod schemas + MDX
content-collections.description: projects collection defined in src/content.config.ts via glob loader over src/content/projects/**/*.mdx. Zod schema validates title, tagline, techStack, status enum, category enum, order, year, and source at build time. Six project case studies present.

component:BaseLayout.responsibility: Wraps every page: SEO meta (astro-seo), OG/Twitter cards, JSON-LD, self-hosted fonts, Umami analytics (PROD-gated), header/footer/mobile menu, chat widget, and client script bootstrap.

component:ChatAPI.responsibility: SSR SSE endpoint streaming Anthropic Haiku with CORS, rate limiting, validation, and KV transcript persistence.

component:Worker.responsibility: Custom Cloudflare Worker entrypoint providing fetch (Astro handler) and scheduled (cron -> deliverDue) handlers plus the Env binding interface.

component:validation.responsibility: Zod request/message schemas, message sanitization, CORS origin allowlist, and body-size constant for the chat API.

component:chat-transcripts.responsibility: Pure KV write module: schema-versioned transcripts, 30-day TTL, 30-turn sliding window, per-session quota, and first-turn metadata pin.

component:chat-delivery.responsibility: Pure cron sweep: partitions live: -> delivered: keyspace, DRY_RUN-gated Resend email send with retry/jitter and batch caps.

component:prompts.responsibility: Pure prompt builders: system-prompt.ts (third-person biographer prompt), chat-request-shape.ts (Anthropic request args with ephemeral prompt caching), portfolio-context-types.ts (context type).
